messages.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

They fit in the **test → debug → validation** part of the workflow as **RF / parametric / characterization lab instruments**, especially for a chip-vendor / semiconductor workflow that needs RF measurements across Lab, R&D, Production, and Operations [72][75].  
For RFIC validation, the closest supported placement is **RF / parametric / characterization**: the knowledge base maps this layer to **R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW, and oscilloscopes** [75].  
The validation workflow these instruments support includes **chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification**, **modem-stack investigation/debug**, **radiated and conducted testing**, and checking that HW/SW works as designed against specs or custom design criteria [24].  
In production/manufacturing-adjacent semiconductor work, the supported need is to **characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver subsystems** and to **debug and trace** [74].  
The **Signal Generator** side can be represented by **R&S SMW200A**, which is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator and can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [6].  
The **Signal Analyzer** side can be represented by **R&S FSW**, a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series, with analysis use cases including EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement in the cited T&M context [7][31].  
【推論】In an RFIC validation workflow, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer would sit after implementation as the bench/lab measurement layer for RF stimulus and RF response analysis during test, debug, and validation, because the cited workflow spans implementation → test → debug → validation and explicitly includes lab equipment interfaces, while the cited product mapping places SMW200A/FSW in RF / parametric / characterization [1][3][75].

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 與 point tools 的區分
問卷第 3b 題要求客戶說明他們是在尋找 point tools，或 broader [[Virtual tester]]：

- point tools examples：better scripting、log analysis。
- broader [[Virtual tester]]：spans implementation → test → debug → validation。

這個區分表示 [[Virtual tester]] 的範圍比單一 scripting assistant 或 log analyzer 更寬，但來源未提供具體產品功能矩陣。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

- 來源將 [[Eutelsat OneWeb]] 描述為 OneWeb constellation operator，並列出 [[OneWeb]] 系統參數：LEO 軌道高度 `750 km`、`600+` 在軌衛星、`100+` 預訂衛星、全球 `±81.4°` 覆蓋、user bands 為 [[Ku-band]] `12–18 GHz` 與 [[Ka-band]] `27–31 GHz`。
- 來源描述 typical terminal peak downlink `150 Mbps`、latency `50–150 ms`、`200+` simultaneous beams；這些數字未提供 datasheet、測試條件或 OneWeb 官方文件引用。
- 來源把 [[OneWeb UT 測試流程]] 分成三階段：第 1–3 個月 laboratory RF test、第 3–5 個月 field link validation、第 5–7 個月 commercialization readiness。
- 第一階段 laboratory RF test 建議選定 [[Intellian]] [[Intellian OW11F]] 或 [[Hughes]] [[Hughes HL1120W]]，量測 G/T、NF、Tx power、link equation，並提到 [[Qorvo]] PA、[[Analog Devices]] LNA、[[MediaTek M80]] 與 `Rohde & Schwarz SMW6` / [[R&S FSW]]。
- 第二階段 field link validation 透過 [[Eutelsat OneWeb]] gateway 做 real-time link testing，含 mobility scenarios、handover latency / CDT、multi-OEM parallel trials 與 [[Sharp]] + [[MediaTek M80]] 5G NTN trial。
- 第三階段 commercialization readiness 包含供應鏈最終化、[[MediaTek]] 5G NTN roadmap、[[工研院]] ITRI gNB development、SLA negotiation 與 2026+ commercial launch roadmap。
- RF 指標區列出 Rx：G/T `18.2 dB/K`（[[Intellian OW11F]]）、NF `<1 dB @ 12 GHz`、gain tolerance `±2 dB`、3 dB bandwidth `500 MHz`；Tx：EIRP `35–45 dBW`、power efficiency `50%+`、PA NF `6–8 dB`、P1dB `35 dBm (2W)`。
- Link budget 區列出 Ku downlink path loss `196 dB`、rain fade margin `4–6 dB` for `99.5%` availability、margin `>3 dB`、QPSK/BPSK SNR `6–8 dB`。
- OEM ecosystem 區列出 [[Intellian]]、[[Hughes]]、[[Kymeta]]、[[Sharp]]，並延伸列出 [[Gilat]] / [[Gilat ESR-2030Ku]]、[[ThinKom]] / [[ThinKom Ka2517]]、[[Satcom Direct]] / [[Plane Simple]]、[[PALS]] / [[PPA-SOTM]]、[[SatixFy]] / [[SatixFy ESMA]]、[[Intelsat]] / [[Intelsat ESA]]、[[Requtech]] / [[RESA]]、[[Asmote]]。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 主要配置與相依關係
- RF path A 必須安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option。
- RF path B 若安裝 `R&S®SMW-B20xx` frequency option，baseband main module 必須是 `R&S®SMW-B13T` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13XT`。
- 必須安裝 `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13XT` 其中一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- `R&S®SMW-B13` 與 `R&S®SMW-B13T` 不能安裝於配備 `R&S®SMW-B1044O`、`R&S®SMW-B2044O`、`R&S®SMW-B1056O` 或 `R&S®SMW-B1067O` frequency options 的儀器。
- `R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` 是 deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`；來源明列 required and only possible for `2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz` RF path combinations。
- 所有已安裝 RF paths 必須具有相同 phase noise performance level；RF path A 的 `R&S®SMW-B709/-B710/-B711` 分別對應 RF path B 的 `R&S®SMW-B719/-B720/-B721`。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 規格適用條件與語彙
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、limit of、minimum 等標示；test limits 透過 guard bands 納入 measurement uncertainties、drift、aging。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

來源內有一項需保留的讀法限制：同段中 `NTN-TDLA100-200` 被文字描述為 100 ms delay spread，但表格對 NTN-TDLA100 列 100 ns delay spread。此處需回查原 PDF / TS 38.181。

- 代表性 RF performance：frequency setting resolution `0.001 Hz`；standard performance SSB phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`20 kHz offset`、`1 Hz measurement bandwidth`、`level = 10 dBm` 條件下為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`；`R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`；rise/fall time 依 frequency option 為 `< 10 ns` 或 `< 15 ns`（fast transition）。
- Wideband baseband `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode 支援 `400 Hz to 600 MHz` sample rate；搭配 `R&S®SMW-K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`，搭配 `R&S®SMW-K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`；對應 RF bandwidth 可到 `500 MHz`、`1000 MHz`、`2000 MHz`。
- 本文件列出 RF、baseband、digital I/Q、AWGN、enhanced noise、envelope tracking、predistortion、digital Doherty、slow I/Q、bandwidth extension、HUMS、remote control、connectors、environmental、ordering information 等資料；option code、licence code 與 order number 只照錄來源列出的內容，不推導缺欄。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 重點摘要
- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`，文件資訊 `PD 3606.8037.22`，`Version 31.00`，日期 `May 2026`，頁尾另標 `May 2026 (ch)`。
- 本文件補齊 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 performance specifications；既有 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 是 `Version 06.00`（`May 2024`）configuration guide，偏向配置規則、retrofitting 與 ordering information。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 RF path A frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/40/44/56/67 GHz`；RF path B 可選 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/44 GHz`。
- 架構可從 single-path [[Vector signal generator]] 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester；來源說明支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources、最多 `64` 個 fading channels，以及最多 `8` 條 RF paths（透過連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules）。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB；可對 baseband signals 做 internal digital adding，包含 frequency offset 與 level offset。
- Standard baseband section 使用 `R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`，RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；wideband baseband section 使用 `R&S®SMW-B13XT`，RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`。
- Internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth in RF 最高 `2 GHz`；2 GHz bandwidth 內 modulation frequency response 為 `< 0.4 dB measured`。
- 支援 internal digital standards，例如 `5G New Radio`、`LTE up to Release 15`、`NB-IoT`、`eMTC`、`3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+`、`GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution`、`WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`DVB-S2/DVB-S2X`；來源同時另列 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]]，其中 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders；單機可實作 `2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4` 等 MIMO fading scenarios。

answer.text:
They fit in the **test → debug → validation** part of the workflow as **RF / parametric / characterization lab instruments**, especially for a chip-vendor / semiconductor workflow that needs RF measurements across Lab, R&D, Production, and Operations [72][75].  
For RFIC validation, the closest supported placement is **RF / parametric / characterization**: the knowledge base maps this layer to **R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW, and oscilloscopes** [75].  
The validation workflow these instruments support includes **chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification**, **modem-stack investigation/debug**, **radiated and conducted testing**, and checking that HW/SW works as designed against specs or custom design criteria [24].  
In production/manufacturing-adjacent semiconductor work, the supported need is to **characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver subsystems** and to **debug and trace** [74].  
The **Signal Generator** side can be represented by **R&S SMW200A**, which is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator and can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [6].  
The **Signal Analyzer** side can be represented by **R&S FSW**, a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series, with analysis use cases including EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement in the cited T&M context [7][31].  
【推論】In an RFIC validation workflow, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer would sit after implementation as the bench/lab measurement layer for RF stimulus and RF response analysis during test, debug, and validation, because the cited workflow spans implementation → test → debug → validation and explicitly includes lab equipment interfaces, while the cited product mapping places SMW200A/FSW in RF / parametric / characterization [1][3][75].

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

5G device testing value chain › ecosystem roles
來源列出的 5G device value chain 角色包含：

- [[Network operator]]。
- [[Device manufacturer]]。
- [[Test house]]。
- [[Chip vendor]]。

這些角色橫跨 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases，不同階段需要不同層級的 test and measurement instruments。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain › Manufacturing 目標
來源指出 manufacturing 測試目標包含：

- High yield of devices with high quality。
- Achieve shortest test time possible；time = money。
- Characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver sub systems。
- Debug and trace。

來源列出的 manufacturing / production 相關工具包含 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] for signaling 與 [[R&S CMQ]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain › 工具與平台 mapping
來源列出下列工具 / 平台 mapping：

| 測試層 | 來源列出的工具 |
|---|---|
| RF / parametric / characterization | [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、Oscilloscopes |
| Signaling / protocol / application | [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMsquares]] |
| OTA / chamber | [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S CMQ]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]] |
| Production / manufacturing | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] |
| Conformance automation | [[R&S CONTEST]] for RRM、PQA、LBS、PCT、NPT、RF OTA |
